title: Exploiting all ancilla outcomes in linear combinations of unitaries: low-rank recovery and quantum trapdoor functions
summary: The linear combination of unitaries (LCU) is a fundamental quantum algorithm primitive that embeds non-unitary operators via post-selection on an ancilla register. In standard LCU, only the $|0\dots0\rangle$ ancilla outcome is retained; the remaining "junk" outcomes are discarded. We study these discarded parts by introducing an alternative LCU circuit which simplifies the coefficient preparation unitary with Hadamard gates and a single rotation qubit. Every computational basis measurement of the ancilla projects the system onto a different linear combination of the target unitaries.…
